facts.text: The UAB Birmingham Promise Scholarship covers tuition for up to 15 credit hours per semester for four years for eligible graduates of Birmingham City public high schools.

sources.title: Birmingham Promise - Cost & Aid
sources.quote: The UAB Birmingham Promise Scholarship covers tuition for up to 15 credit hours per semester and may be awarded for up to four years (8 semesters) of full-time undergraduate study at UAB.
